story.en: An old game console sent a hollow electronic hum: richer than a whistle, with mainly odd upper harmonics, but no sharp edge. Build it with the harmonic faders. Pitch, envelope and effects are fixed. The notebook accepts a family of sounds, not one secret preset. Start with H2 and H3; more controls open at higher difficulties.
story.zh-Hant: 舊遊戲機傳來一個空心的電子嗡聲：比哨音豐富，高次諧波主要偏向奇數，但不尖銳。用諧波推桿重建它；音高、包絡與效果固定。筆記接受一類合理音色，而非唯一秘密預設。入門先調 H2、H3，較高難度開放更多控制。
